title: Fine-Tuning Low-Bit Models with Gradient in Quantized Code Space
abstract: arXiv:2608.30908v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning Low-bit models aims to adapt a quantized model while keeping the final deployed checkpoint in the same low-bit form. This setting is practically important as it reduces memory and inference cost for storage and deployment. Under this constraint, adaptation becomes an optimization problem over quantization codes and scales. Existing continuous low-bit training is efficient, but it can be distorted by straight through estimation error or by post-quantize gap; discrete search is deployment-faithful, but it is often too inefficient under a finite training budget. We propose code surrogate gradient as the first order signal in deployable code space to acceleate optimization, and performing guided search to preserve deployment faithfulness. translated_title: 在量化码空间中利用梯度微调低比特模型
translated_abstract: 微调低比特模型旨在对量化模型进行适配，同时保持最终部署的检查点仍处于相同的低比特形式。这一设置具有重要的实际意义，因为它降低了存储和部署时的内存占用与推理成本。在这一约束下，适配过程成为对量化码和缩放因子的优化问题。现有的连续低比特训练虽然高效，但可能因直通估计误差或量化后差异而产生失真；离散搜索虽然对部署是忠实的，但在有限的训练预算下往往效率过低。我们提出码代理梯度作为可部署码空间中的一阶信号以加速优化，并进行引导搜索以保持部署的忠实性。在算术推理、指令遵循和结构化语言理解任务上的实验表明，GradCodes 在不同的量化设置下均能持续提升低比特模型的微调效果。
tldr: 提出码代理梯度方法，在可部署的量化码空间中利用一阶梯度信号加速优化，并结合引导搜索保持部署忠实性，从而在不同量化设置下持续提升低比特模型的微调效果。
en_tdlr: GradCodes proposes code surrogate gradients as first-order signals in the deployable quantized code space to accelerate optimization, combined with guided search to preserve deployment faithfulness, consistently improving low-bit model fine-tuning across different quantization settings.
